notes: Bare printed names written with Street: WITLER, LAKEMAN, HANFIELD, TURRILL, CHERRY, BLUE ROCK, and the southern DELANEY. The DELANEY running north from Chase is a different street from the southern DELANEY (about 1200 px apart, separated by the asylum grounds); it is recorded as Delaney Avenue to match sheet 631. Cherry north of Chase and Cherry south of the asylum are likewise separate pieces. Blue Rock is printed 130' wide east of Cherry (widening toward 623). Turrill runs SSE off the east edge. Circled numbers (100', 90', 78', 80', 89', 83', 74', 71') are grade elevations, not widths.
